Name: Constellation Energy Corp
Description: Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG) is a leading energy producer in the United States, headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland. The company specializes in providing clean and reliable energy solutions, with a focus on nuclear and renewable energy sources. As a major player in the energy sector, Constellation is committed to sustainability and innovation, positioning itself to meet the growing demand for environmentally responsible energy. With a robust portfolio that includes both generation and retail services, Constellation Energy is well-equipped to navigate the evolving energy landscape and capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
